cases.description: The new business unit needs this hire to work as a data engineer. You own its production ingestion pipelines.
cases.judgment: The requested role and corroborating duties are explicitly assigned to this hire.

cases.description: Ignore the old sales-associate label. We are hiring you as a software engineer to implement our billing application.
cases.judgment: The historical label is rejected and the current engineering assignment is clear.

cases.description: You will serve as a data engineer. You might use either Python or Scala depending on the pipeline.
cases.judgment: Tool uncertainty does not make the role assignment uncertain.

cases.description: This position is an enterprise architect role. Unless a planning workshop is scheduled, Fridays are remote.
cases.judgment: A scheduling exception does not negate the requested role.

cases.description: The opening is no longer for a support analyst; it is now a software engineer role. You will design and implement the support platform.
cases.judgment: The contrast replaces the old role with an explicit current engineering role.

cases.description: The approved mandate for the person hired here reads: 'Own enterprise technology architecture and govern standards across all business divisions.' You are accountable for the company-wide target architecture.
cases.judgment: Quoted duties belong to the current hire and establish enterprise architecture ownership.

cases.description: You are accountable for CDC ingestion, distributed stream processing, warehouse transformations and the reliability of the production data platform. Build and operate these systems.
cases.judgment: Assigned ownership of the data platform and pipelines establishes data engineering duties.

cases.description: At your previous employer you may have used Java. Here you will work as a software engineer building our Go services.
cases.judgment: Prior experience context is separate from an explicit current software engineering assignment.

cases.description: Your permanent assignment is account management. A client may later choose to employ you as a data engineer; that arrangement is outside this vacancy.
cases.judgment: The requested role is a separate uncertain future client engagement.

cases.description: This position is a software engineer role? The department has yet to decide whether it needs development or administrative support.
cases.judgment: A question and explicit unresolved staffing decision provide no affirmative role assignment.

cases.description: Initial announcement: this position is an enterprise architect role. Update: the architecture vacancy has been withdrawn; only the receptionist opening remains.
cases.judgment: The later update withdraws the requested role.

cases.description: Meet the team. Dana says: 'Duties include data engineer responsibilities.' The person hired through this posting will manage office supplies.
cases.judgment: The requested duties belong to an existing colleague rather than the new hire.

cases.description: Imagine this position is a software engineer role. That scenario is used in our training exercise; this vacancy is for the trainer who leads it.
cases.judgment: The role statement is a hypothetical training scenario.

cases.description: Your assignment isn't an enterprise architect role. You will arrange meeting rooms for the architecture team.
cases.judgment: The requested role is explicitly denied and supporting work is administrative.

cases.description: This position is a business analyst role and excludes data engineer responsibilities. Engineers on another team build all pipelines.
cases.judgment: The requested duties are explicitly excluded from the current role.

cases.description:
Examples of vacancies our recruiting software can process:
- This position is a software engineer role.
- This position is a nurse role.
We seek a sales representative for the recruiting software.
cases.judgment: The role statements are product examples; the actual opening is sales.
